safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not document family history being non-significant (Family_History section is empty).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting documentation of a non-significant family history has minimal impact on immediate clinical decision-making in an acute insect sting/allergic reaction assessment, where airway symptoms and personal allergy history drive management. The main consequence is reduced completeness of the record rather than a change in care.
